text: “Pray do; I assure you that it is not mere curiosity that prompts me.” By this time we had reached the point at which the Drunstall road, by which the General had come, diverges from the road which we were traveling to Karnstein. “How far is it to the ruins?” inquired the General, looking anxiously forward. “About half a league,” answered my father. “Pray let us hear the story you were so good as to promise.” XI. The Story With all my heart,” said the General, with an effort; and after a short pause in which to arrange his subject, he commenced one of the strangest narratives I ever heard.
